description: Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis, intelligent staging, and message generation. Use when user asks to commit changes, create a git commit, or mentions /commit (trigger phrases - commit, git commit, 触发词 - 提交代码, 提交一下, 提交规范). Auto-detects type and scope from the diff, generates conventional commit messages, and stages files in logical groups.
